verdict.rationale: Supabase ships its own natural-language operation surfaces. The Dashboard AI Assistant generates schema SQL from your specifications, debugs SQL errors, and can generate and deploy Edge Functions. The official MCP server and agent plugin let AI assistants query data, run migrations, deploy functions and manage projects on your behalf. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and documentation of how far the in-dashboard Assistant can act beyond SQL generation and function deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: when designing a new database schema, it can generate all necessary SQL queries based on your specifications
You can also use Supabase's AI Assistant to generate and deploy functions automatically.
Once connected, your AI assistants can interact with and query your Supabase projects on your behalf.
Once connected, your agent can call tools to query data, run migrations, deploy Edge Functions, and more.
